name: What are the typical costs associated with non-glare lighting upgrades?

mainEntity.name: What are the typical costs associated with non-glare lighting upgrades?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of non-glare lighting upgrades varies significantly based on the scope of work, types of fixtures chosen, and electrical modifications required. For a single room, replacing a few standard fixtures with low-glare LED alternatives might range from a few hundred to over a thousand dollars, including materials and installation. Whole-house upgrades involving recessed lighting, track lighting with diffusers, or specialized architectural lighting can cost several thousand dollars or more. Factors like ceiling access, existing wiring, and the need for new switches or dimmers also influence the final price. We provide detailed estimates after an on-site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for non-glare lighting upgrades vary widely depending on the project scope, fixture types, and electrical work needed, ranging from hundreds for a room to thousands for whole-house systems.
